result:
All gates are met. Final state:

**Root cause** — `updateTerminal` in `variants/bug07/movegen.inc` asked the wrong question when a side had no legal moves: it called `moverInCheck` (which ignores its argument and tests the side that just *moved*, so it is never in check after a legal move) instead of `inCheckSide(sideToMove)`, so every mate fell through to the stalemate branch.

**Files touched**
- `variants/bug07/movegen.inc` — the fix: `call moverInCheck` → `call inCheckSide` in `updateTerminal`, plus a comment. Only source-code change; same 3-byte instruction, so `chess.bin`/`chess.tap` sizes are unchanged.
- `variants/bug07/chess.bin`, `chess.tap` — rebuilt.
- `variants/bug07/test_terminal.py` — new 7-case regression test (asserts reached FEN + `gameState` byte + status line).
- `variants/bug07/Makefile` — runs the new test; also added the three includes missing from `SRC` (`perft.inc`, `zobrist.inc`, `tt.inc`), which could have let `make test` check a stale tape.
- `variants/bug07/BUILD.md` — documents the test; two corrected claims.
- `FIX_NOTES.md`, `STATE.md` at the workspace root.

**Gates**
- Reported symptom no longer reproduces — pass. All five bug-report commands: three mates now `black-mated`/`white-mated` with the right "Checkmate! … wins" line; stalemate control still `stalemate`; check control still `play`.
- `make test` — pass (golden board, 1.e4 reply, perft, save/load round-trip, 128K banked TT, 7 terminal-state cases).
- New test — pass, and proven to fail on broken builds: reverted 4/7 fail, inverted check sense 6/7 fail, and `make test` on the reverted build exits 2.
- Review round — pass. Two synchronous rounds. Round 1 raised 6 findings (vacuous control case, coverage gap, doc nits, Makefile `SRC`, temp-dir leak, plus F3 below); round 2 found no code/test/build defects and 6 write-up inaccuracies. All addressed; no findings outstanding.

**Knowingly left open** — `resetGameState` (`chess.asm:1625`) doesn't classify the position it loads, so loading an already-mated position isn't announced; with the engine to move it also logs a phantom move (`moveLog e8d7` on an unchanged board). Pre-existing, on the set-up path rather than the after-a-move path, unaffected by this fix, and left out on the round-1 reviewer's recommendation to file it separately. Documented under "Known, left open" in `FIX_NOTES.md`.

One note: the ~8900 stale `/tmp/zxchess.*` directories from earlier harness runs are outside the workspace and untouched; the underlying leak is in `harness/tools/play.py`, and the new test no longer contributes to it.
